notes:
Replace the sample row before uploading.
Dates use m/d/Y.
business_type: SOLE PROPRIETORSHIP, ONE PERSON CORPORATION, PARTNERSHIP, CORPORATION, or COOPERATIVE.
Fill dti_no for sole proprietorship, sec_no for corporation or partnership, and cda_no for cooperative.
incharge_sex: M or F.
activity_type: MAIN OFFICE, BRANCH OFFICE, ADMIN OFFICE ONLY, or WAREHOUSE.
location_owned: 1 or 0.
When location_owned is 1, fill tdn_no or pin_no. Both may be filled.
Leave them blank when location_owned is 0.
Use letters, numbers, dashes, and underscores.
tdn_no is at most 20 characters.
